pillars.name: 1. Hardware & Coil System
pillars.desc: 20 kHz – 1 MHz excitation coil, triaxial active guard & 6-layer reference phantoms

subWorkflows.name: Probe & Coil Fabrication
subWorkflows.desc: Pancake coil winding, MnZn ferrite cup core, Litz wire & active triaxial shielding (20 kHz – 1 MHz)

subWorkflows.name: Reference Standards & 6-Layer Blocks
subWorkflows.desc: 6-layer stratified metallic plates, 4-point Kelvin ground-truth & precision liftoff shims

pillars.name: 2. DAQ & Signal Processing
pillars.desc: 10-tone multisine (20 kHz – 1 MHz) I/Q demodulation, impedance transfer & C-scan mapping

subWorkflows.name: Data Acquisition Algorithm & Demodulation
subWorkflows.desc: 10-frequency Schroeder multisine (20 kHz – 1 MHz), synchronous I/Q lock-in & affine Z calibration

subWorkflows.name: Spatial C-Scan Mapping & Formatting
subWorkflows.desc: 2D X-Y gantry synchronization, spatial grid mapping & calibrated .mat impedance tensor export

pillars.name: 3. Inversion Algorithm
pillars.desc: Analytical 6-layer forward solver, synthetic pretraining & Sim-to-Real conductivity tomography

subWorkflows.name: Simulation Validation & Forward Modeling
subWorkflows.desc: Vectorized Dodd-Deeds 6-layer analytical solver (20 kHz – 1 MHz), COMSOL FEM & 80k synthetic dataset

subWorkflows.name: Pretraining & 6-Layer Inversion Network
subWorkflows.desc: PINN/ResNet-1D synthetic pretraining, Sim-to-Real transfer & σ₁…σ₆ reconstruction

milestones.title: 2D-3D Coherence
milestones.summary: This task is used to evaluate the coherence of building our forward model using the 2D axisymmetric method and the 3D method in COMSOL Multiphysics.

milestones.title: Data Preparation
milestones.summary: Using a 2D axisymmetric model in COMSOL Multiphysics to generate a large number of impedance data. (150,000)

milestones.title: DNN Network
milestones.summary:
Constructed a 20-feature-input, 6-feature-output DNN.
